name: Eldreth Row
summary: Gordunni ogres patrol Eldreth Row, the ruined western halls of Dire Maul. Overgrown stone once marked the outer threshold of ancient Eldre'Thalas.

sections.title: The Threshold of Eldre'Thalas
sections.body: Eldreth Row opens onto the outer halls of ancient Eldre'Thalas. The avenue lies before the deeper quarters and the Broken Commons. Centuries of neglect have cracked the stone, and Feralas plants overrun its colonnades. The Highborne halls now serve the Gordunni ogres as a staging ground. Their patrols guard the paths east toward the Warpwood Quarter and west past the Dire Pool.

faq.answer: Eldreth Row is Dire Maul's outer entrance hall in Feralas. It lies before the Broken Commons and the inner gateways.

faq.q: Who controls Eldreth Row right now?
faq.answer: Gordunni ogres occupy Eldreth Row and patrol its broken avenues, guarding the Dire Maul ruins.
Eldreth Row leads inward toward the Broken Commons and Dire Maul's main complexes. The Warpwood Quarter lies to the east, and the Dire Pool to the west.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may see in Eldre'Thalas's ancient masonry a reminder of the Highborne's fall and the Sundering. Ogres now hold the ruins.
